epics.title: Clean lightweight workboard animations
epics.description: Make the workboard feel responsive using restrained Magic UI, existing Motion, or CSS effects. Build on the completed multi-workspace navigation. Motion should explain changes, preserve focus, respect reduced motion and stay lightweight. Existing metrics already use Magic UI; audit and reuse them before adding anything. Planned follow-on work; implementation has not started.

tasks.title: Define lightweight motion rules and audit existing animations
tasks.description: Audit existing Magic UI Number Ticker, Animated Circular Progress Bar, motion dependency and CSS transitions. Define shared duration/easing/distance tokens and where animation clarifies action. Prefer existing dependencies and CSS; avoid decorative continuous motion.
acceptance: Inventory current motion and identify redundant effects.
Specify subtle 120–220 ms feedback, reduced-motion behavior and keyboard/focus invariants.
Document bundle/runtime baseline and prohibit new dependencies without a measured need.

tasks.title: Animate task board updates and stage changes
tasks.description: Add restrained entry/exit/reorder and stage transition feedback. Distinguish a user action from background polling; maintain stable task identity and avoid reanimating unchanged cards. Reuse Motion or CSS and existing design tokens.
acceptance: Create/move/archive transitions remain smooth and preserve scroll, focus and drag/drop.
Polling unchanged data does not replay card animations.
Reduced motion updates immediately without movement; large boards stay responsive.

tasks.title: Add consistent drawer dialog and navigation transitions
tasks.description: Apply short opacity/position transitions to task drawers, dialogs and view changes. Coordinate exit animations with overlay cleanup; keep focus trapping/return, Escape and outside-click semantics intact.
acceptance: Rapid open/close and repeated navigation do not leave overlays or stale content.
Keyboard focus and screen reader dialog state remain correct throughout transitions.
Small-screen layouts and reduced motion preserve immediate access.

tasks.title: Refine status metrics and action feedback
tasks.description: Reuse existing Magic UI counters/progress sparingly; add lightweight feedback for save, task state and loading-to-ready changes. Keep global and workspace contexts distinct. Do not animate values across different workspace identities.
acceptance: Counters only animate actual changes within one scope.
Unknown and partial metrics never animate as zero or imply false precision.
Errors, disconnected state and confirmations remain readable without animation.

tasks.title: Verify motion accessibility performance and consistency
tasks.description: Review combined animations on representative large boards, desktop/mobile, light/dark themes and reduced-motion settings. Measure bundle change and inspect layout/long tasks. Remove effects that distract from work or harm responsiveness.
acceptance: Test rapid task updates, polling, navigation and concurrent edits without flicker.
Reduced-motion, keyboard and screen reader semantics pass.
Document before/after bundle and runtime observations; no continuous idle animation or unnecessary dependency growth.
